shortDesc: Interactive Tic-Tac-Toe powered by a custom reinforcement learning model.
fullDesc:
A complete Tic-Tac-Toe game hosted on the web that plays against users using an AI agent trained from scratch using reinforcement learning.

Core Idea:
The project consists of a Python model trainer (Tic-tac-toe-model) implementing Q-Learning to train the computer to make optimal moves. The trained policy is exported as JSON and evaluated in the frontend client (hosted-tictactoe) to play games in real time with zero latency and zero server-side computation.
highlights: Q-Learning reinforcement learning agent trained locally in Python
Zero-server inference by running the policy engine directly in the browser JS
Clean, interactive layout with win/loss trackers and difficulty modes

subRepoOverviews.Tic-tac-toe-model: Python training code, algorithms, and notebooks training a reinforcement learning Q-Agent to execute optimal moves.
